title: Florida vs Miami Prediction: Sunshine State Make-or-Break Moment For the Gators - NewsBreak
text:
By Pete Fiutak ,
2 hours ago No one needs a win more than the Florida Gators.
To go dark, this might be it for head coach Billy Napier. The Gators started 1-2, with the offense failing against USF and then turning it over way too much in last week’s 20-10 loss to LSU. With Texas and Texas A&M up next, it’s uh-oh time with another misfire.
On the flip side, the entire season could change around with a win over the Hurricanes.
Unlike Florida, Miami dropkicked USF in a 49-12 win last week. Throw in the win over Notre Dame, and this is as strong as the team has looked in years.
Now it’s time to prove that it really is good enough to be in the mix for the national title with this, Florida State, and Louisville up next.
Florida Gators vs Miami Hurricanes Game Preview Sep 13, 2025; Baton Rouge, Louisiana, USA; Florida Gators quarterback DJ Lagway (2) passes against the Florida Gators during the first half at Tiger Stadium.© Stephen Lew-Imagn Images
Florida vs Miami How To Watch Saturday, September 20, 2025
Game Time: 7:30 PM ET
TV: ABC
Location: Hard Rock Stadium, Miami Gardens, FL
@PeteFiutak
Why Florida Will Win The defense is still tremendous.
The offense isn't all that bad, it's just not timely, and there are too many mistakes. The defense, though, has been lights out, stuffing the LSU running game last week - causing Tiger head coach Brian Kelly to blow a tire when asked the most basic of questions about his offense.
The D is great on third downs, there have been a few takeaways, and allowing 38 points in three games is good no matter what. The Gators have the defensive front to hold up against the Miami NFL talent up front, but ...
Sep 13, 2025; Miami Gardens, Florida, USA; Miami Hurricanes quarterback Carson Beck (11) reacts against the South Florida Bulls during the second quarter at Hard Rock Stadium.© Sam Navarro-Imagn Images
Why Miami Will Win There's no Gator pass rush.
For all of the good things the Florida defense does, it doesn't get into the backfield, there are just two sacks so far, and that's a massive problem if Miami quarterback Carson Beck gets time to work.
All the Georgia transfer has done is hit 79% of his passes for 812 yards and seven scores. The two interceptions against USF didn't matter, considering the deep shots he was hitting opened things up.
It's possible to throw on the Florida defense as long as you take what it gives you. Beck is a veteran who knows what he's doing, and he won't take many chances because ...
Is This When Florida Rises Up and Rocks? Last year, all was lost for a 5-5 Florida team, and then it put up two brilliant performances in wins over LSU and Ole Miss.
The second half of 2023 was a problem, but early on, it dominated Tennessee in a 13-point win. Can the Gators pull off one of those stunners from out of nowhere?
There's a problem with those losses to LSU, Ole Miss, and Tennessee over the last few years - those were all in Gainesville.
This is when Miami shows just how real it is, and it starts by winning on the lines.
